findings.title: Error message does not match raised condition
findings.body: The check on line 10 raises when `days < MIN_RETENTION_DAYS`, but the message on line 11 says `retention below {MIN_RETENTION_DAYS} days is not allowed`, which implies the threshold is exclusive. Make the message match the condition: `retention of {MIN_RETENTION_DAYS} days or fewer is not allowed`.
findings.suggestion: raise ValueError(f"retention of {MIN_RETENTION_DAYS} days or fewer is not allowed")

findings.title: Return value not incremented
findings.body: The loop on line 13 calls `delete(name)` and then increments `removed` on line 15, but the shown code does not increment `removed` after each deletion. The function always returns 0, so callers cannot know how many files were removed. Increment `removed` inside the loop.

summary.problem: The retention policy enforces a minimum age but returns an incorrect count and shows a mismatched error message.
summary.done_well: A minimum retention threshold is enforced to prevent accidental data loss.
